steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each vendor is placed by its spend against its contract limit.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 vendor is above its contract limit

findings.title: Spend above the contract limit
findings.fix: Stop the spend or agree a change in writing

findings.title: Spend total does not match its invoices

outcome.notChecked: Whether the goods or services were received.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] vendor-b.csv:12  Spend above the contract limit.
       Fix: Stop the spend or agree a change in writing.
[medium] vendor-d.csv:19  Spend with no contract.
       Fix: Put the vendor under contract.
[low] vendor-f.csv:26  Spend total does not match its invoices.
       Fix: Recompute from the invoices.
Not checked: Whether the goods or services were received.
pros: Checks spend above the contract limit, a vendor with spend and no contract, and a spend total that does not match its invoices.
cons: Not checked: Whether the goods or services were received.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-ops-vendor-spend-review skill on the records for this review.
